records.source: A decorative piece for your farm.
It's way too large to wear.
Prevents crows from attacking your crops. Has a limited radius (about 8 "tiles").
records.translation: Pinipigilan ang mga uwak na salakayin ang mga pananim mo. Limitado ang saklaw nito (mga 8 "parisukat").

records.source: This decoration changes with the seasons.
records.translation: Nagbabago ang palamuting ito ayon sa panahon.

records.source: An ornamental plant that changes with each season. It doesn't need to be watered.
records.translation: Pandekorasyong halamang nagbabago sa bawat panahon. Hindi ito kailangang diligan.

records.source: Place crops inside to produce a varying amount of seeds. Doesn't work with fruit tree crops.
records.translation: Maglagay ng mga pananim sa loob upang makagawa ng pabago-bagong dami ng binhi. Hindi ito gumagana sa mga ani ng punong namumunga.

records.source: Use to tailor clothes from the convenience of your home!
records.translation: Gamitin upang maginhawang manahi ng mga damit sa bahay mo!

records.source: A decorative piece for your farm.
It rings out with a pure tone when struck.
records.translation: Tumutunog ito nang dalisay kapag hinampas.

records.source: Provides a moderate amount of light.
Compresses 100 pieces of slime into a slime egg. It's a miracle of science!
records.translation: Pinipisil ang 100 piraso ng slime upang maging itlog ng slime. Himala ito ng agham!

records.source: Hatches slimes eggs into slimes. Allows you to raise slimes outdoors.
records.translation: Pinapapisa ang mga itlog ng slime upang maging mga slime. Maaari kang mag-alaga ng mga slime sa labas.

records.source: This extinct sloth roamed the lush, prehistoric forests of Stardew Valley. Its powerful jaw tore through the toughest plant fibers.
records.translation: Lipol na ang uri ng sloth na ito, na gumala sa malalagong sinaunang kagubatan ng Stardew Valley. Pinupunit ng malakas nitong panga maging ang pinakamatitibay na hibla ng halaman.

records.source: The ribs of a prehistoric sloth.
records.translation: Mga tadyang ng isang sinaunang sloth.

records.source: The hind legs and tail of a prehistoric sloth.
records.translation: Mga hulihang binti at buntot ng isang sinaunang sloth.

records.source: Keeps pumping out the good stuff.
records.translation: Patuloy itong naglalabas ng masarap na bagay.

records.source: Slowly generates batteries when left in the sun.
records.translation: Dahan-dahang gumagawa ng mga baterya kapag iniwan sa araw.

records.source: Use this to move down a level in the mines.
records.translation: Gamitin ito upang bumaba ng isang antas sa mga minahan.

records.source: It's a huge geode mounted on a stand. Hundreds of purple crystals shimmer within.
records.translation: Napakalaking heoda itong nakapatong sa patungan. Daan-daang lilang kristal ang kumikislap sa loob.

records.source: The most prestigious award a Stardew Valley resident could receive!
records.translation: Ang pinakaprestihiyosong gantimpalang maaaring matanggap ng isang residente ng Stardew Valley!

records.source: Touching the statue gives a unique blessing every day.
records.translation: Ang paghawak sa estatwa ay nagbibigay ng natatanging basbas bawat araw.

records.source: It's made of solid gold. What's it for?
records.translation: Gawa ito sa purong ginto. Para saan ito?
